mandatoryHigherOrder.precondition: typical/heavy hot:two conversations local2s stream+local1s tool concurrent

multiple nonempty documents, competing designs, grouped images/videos with version histories and references; at least2 native Agent conversations in overlapping stream/tool work; named window/language/platform
mandatoryHigherOrder.input: switch/edit drafts and plans; select/arrange mixed group; operate concurrent foreground/background Agents; preview, local export and save; interrupt and cold restart/recover
mandatoryHigherOrder.visibleCompletion: all user-visible workspace/content and independent per-conversation receipts remain attributable; preview/export/save output completes or explicit failure/cancel is visible; recovered state resumes without stale cross-project writes
mandatoryHigherOrder.dataAssertion: document/design/group/history/reference identities retained; native lane transcript prefixes retained and no cross-conversation replies; export media is decodable and save matches intended edits; interrupted work has durable recovery evidence

constraints: Local Agent peer drives production runtime; labels/timers insufficient.
Stay offline and retain production permission semantics.
Reload needs cross-document probe; project.open rejects reload.
Unsupported combinations need source-backed not-applicable reason, never silent removal.
expandedConstraints: concurrency1 cannot have parallel stream-stream/tool-tool/stream-tool or simultaneous foreground-and-background sessions
Only eligible pairs under the stated constraint are required; all other dimensions retain their full cross-product pair coverage
All rows are plans, including unsupported-reference/error/cancel/recovery and native platforms; no execution or timing is inferred
